description: From the medieval street, Santillana del Mar glows under its street lamps — the old stone houses and their wooden balconies lit warm along the cobbled lane, with the collegiate church's towers rising at the street's end. The lamps catch the honey-colored stone and the carved coats of arms, and the whole village feels suspended in time. They call it the town of three lies; tonight it's simply beautiful.
